visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man in a black polo shirt stands in a studio with a light blue and white background. He gestures broadly with his hands and has an expressive face. Text overlays appear at the top and bottom of the frame, and small cartoon illustrations of children appear periodically to represent behavioral stages. (2) He introduces the first parenting tip, and large graphic text overlays appear over his chest. He uses hand gestures to demonstrate a 'no' sign and then a 'parallel' motion. A cartoon of a child jumping in a puddle is shown briefly. (3) For the second tip, he holds up a colorful children's book titled '為什麼要說對不起' (Why say sorry?). He points to the book's cover while explaining how to use stories to teach rules. (4) During the third tip, he gestures towards the camera while text boxes with open-ended 'Why' questions appear. Red 'X' marks are used to signify incorrect ways of asking children questions. (5) For the fourth tip, he contrasts 'You can' with 'You can't' using green checkmarks and red 'X' graphics. He points downwards to indicate a physical location during his explanation. (6) The video concludes with the man gesturing towards the viewer, followed by a white screen showing a YouTube logo and channel information.
